title: Bike spec
description: Runtime metadata for a hoverbike asset. The .blend at bikes-src/<id>.blend is the source of truth for geometry / sockets / collider; this spec carries the manifest-facing display name, physics overrides applied to bike_root extras at build time, and appearance hex colors used for material recolor + garage-menu swatches.

id.description: Stable identifier — also the GLB filename.

geometry.description: Legacy kit-assembly knobs — IGNORED by the per-variant build_bike.py. Kept here so older specs validate. Edit bikes-src/<id>.blend to change geometry; the spec block is no-op.

rider.description: Legacy rider-attach data — IGNORED by the per-variant build_bike.py. The seat anchor lives on socket_seat in bikes-src/<id>.blend. Kept so older specs validate.
